# PST fixture

`tasks.pst` is a synthetic Unicode PST generated by the production PST writer
and task-property mapping. It contains one task with UTF-16 text, a completion
date, due date, UTC reminder, multiple categories, a small UTF-8 file, a
9,000-byte binary attachment crossing PST block boundaries, and FerroUI
step/repeat metadata. A second standard task has no FerroUI metadata; an empty
task folder must survive; an ordinary email must be skipped.
It contains no real mailbox data.

`fidelity.pst` contains five synthetic tasks checking source-preserving export
of in-progress/waiting/deferred status, low importance, percent complete,
start dates, precise timestamps, and the Microsoft To Do body-modification
named property. Two tasks deliberately change local completion/importance and
verify that those edits override the source projection.

`rich-notes.pst` contains Unicode notes with emphasis, links, a bulleted list,
and structured steps. Its second task has a formatting-only Outlook edit while
retaining the earlier FerroUI metadata, proving that the edited HTML wins.

Regenerate with `node scripts/generate-pst-fixture.mjs`. The JavaScript test
checks byte-for-byte reproducibility. Rust tests independently decode the
file with Microsoft's `outlook-pst` reference implementation and verify its
task fields, named-property mapping, file bytes, and malformed-file handling.

PST writer attribution is in
`crates/todo-browser/wwwroot/vendor/pst-writer/LICENSE`.
